biotools.summary: Points2Regions is a Python tool integrated into TissUUmaps and Napari for clustering spatial biomarkers in omics data. It enables fast and efficient region discovery across multiple scales without relying on additional data, facilitating exploratory analysis of imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data.
biotools.name: Points2Regions
